# eon_idp_group (Resource)

Creates and manages an IDP (Identity Provider) group mapping. An IDP group represents a group from your Identity Provider (e.g. Okta, SAML) and maps it to one or more Eon roles. When users authenticate via SSO and belong to this group, they receive the assigned roles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Map an IdP group to a single Eon role
resource "eon_idp_group" "admins" {
  idp_id            = "04032c6d-91b3-4bd6-8a22-0d5f4934f8e7"  # Identity Provider ID from Eon
  provider_group_id = "00g1abc2def3ghi4j"  # Group ID from your IdP (e.g. Okta group ID)
  role_ids          = ["role-admin-uuid"]
}

# Map an IdP group to multiple Eon roles
resource "eon_idp_group" "developers" {
  idp_id            = "04032c6d-91b3-4bd6-8a22-0d5f4934f8e7"
  provider_group_id = "00g9xyz8wvu7tsr6q"
  role_ids          = ["role-reader-uuid", "role-backup-operator-uuid"]
}

# Output the IDP group identifier
output "admin_idp_group_id" {
  value = eon_idp_group.admins.id
}
```

## Import

Import an existing IDP group by its Eon-assigned ID:

```bash
terraform import eon_idp_group.example <group_id>
```

The `idp_id`, `provider_group_id`, and `role_ids` will be populated from the API.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `idp_id` (String) The ID of the Identity Provider this group belongs to.
- `provider_group_id` (String) The group identifier from the Identity Provider (e.g. Okta group ID, SAML group name).
- `role_ids` (List of String) List of Eon role IDs assigned to this IDP group. Users in this IdP group will receive these roles when they sign in.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) System-generated unique identifier for the IDP group.
